decisions.statement: The readings are taken on the workstation with the checkout.
Each reading is kept beside the readout that reading was taken for.
Each reading is kept beside its attribute's page as that attribute's points today.
The attribute a readout counts is read off that readout's own link.
That link reads back as the slug alone, whatever page type names it.
The question to ask and how to read each answer are on each readout's own page.
The stretch keys are spelled back to the store's own spelling for the guard.
The guard reading each attribute is akasha's own and is unchanged here.
The plants the constitution counts are asked for through the plants reading module.
The rejections the luck counts are asked for through that same module.
The constitution and the luck are counted over the window the day opened.
A source's throws are carried by that source's promise rather than raised at the call.
A source that could not be read is named on stderr with the reason that source gave.
A day nobody has opened yet is an absent reading rather than an unreachable source.
Each readout is named as soon as that readout's reading is kept.
An attribute's points today are named as soon as those points are kept.
A reading kept is named before the points that reading writes, which can throw.
A run that kept a reading exits 0.
A run that kept no reading exits 2.
A run of this file takes the seven readings.
The root read is the root the environment states or the folder the call was made in.
An empty value in the environment states no root.
Each readout's path is spelled here rather than asked of the index.
The points themselves are never printed.
Importing this file takes no reading.
Nothing here decides when a reading is due.

definition: the seven attribute points Alan earned today, read and kept on their own readouts
